flows:
Navigate to https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Traverse the homepage header.
When the site search icon gets focus, @v16:"press Enter and verify a search field opens".
If focus runs past the header without stopping at the search icon, @v16:"verify that the search field stays closed".
